blocks.text: Behind the masks: French Ambassador Donatienne Hissard (center) and SM Supermalls President Steven Tan (right) with Le Fantôme de l’Opéra (The Phantom of the Opera) director Alexandre Castagnetti, who was honored at the 29th French Film Festival gala reception at SM Aura. Caastagnetti’s Phantom is a personal interprétation of Gaston Leroux’s classic taking audiences deep into the halls of the Opéra Garnier with spectacular ballet performances and set in modern day Paris.
